user_instruction_summary: 接管小说最新任务；现有执行过慢，希望由Codex处理，并询问如何接入AI评测。

proposed_design.coordinator: One Codex coordinator owns repository writes and verifies review evidence
proposed_design.writer: Fresh isolated context reads only the approved writer packet
proposed_design.reader_review: Fresh isolated context initially receives only anonymous frozen prose and minimal reading context
proposed_design.fact_review: Separate factual review receives prose and necessary locked story facts, without reader verdict
proposed_design.transport: Prefer structured reviewer output returned directly to coordinator when supported; API is an alternative if separately configured
proposed_design.calibration: Use held-out known human-labelled failures and available scope-matched positives; freeze blind results before labels are disclosed. Existing missed negatives and absent matched positives prevent certification of personal-taste agreement
proposed_design.budget: Preserve existing bounded authorization; do not reset exhausted budgets or loop until an AI returns PASS
proposed_design.acceptance: AI screening and actual human literary acceptance remain distinct

source_coverage: Current pinned authority bundle and native check complete; full historical chats and runtime integrations not audited
